name: ChamAlien
abilities: Camouflage - blends into surroundings until effectively invisible
Sharp teeth and claws (damaged Exo-Skull's armour)
Enhanced strength (pushed cars and a truck; beat a Vulpimancer)
weaknesses: Only changes colour - his shadow shows and bright lights expose him
Tracked by Vulpimancers' senses and by Anodites via manna
Camouflage fails if he carries objects or is coated in powder/oil
Can be controlled by Vladat Corrupturas
summary: A purple salamander alien with three-coloured eye lenses who turns nearly invisible - Ben's stealth form, scanned from the Area 51 escapee Prisoner 775.
traits: Three eyes hidden behind blue, green and red lenses
Only used in Ultimate Alien Season 3
notableFeats: Tried out immediately after scanning Prisoner 775 (Prisoner Number 775 is Missing)
Snuck into the Flame Keepers' Circle building unseen (The Flame Keepers' Circle)
Hid from Gwen and Kevin in a dream (Night of the Living Nightmare)

appearances.designNotes: Slim purple salamander with darker camo spots, short tail, black helmet with three triangular lenses (blue/green/red), spike fin, four fingers and frog-like three-toed feet; Ultimatrix symbol on chest.

image.label: UA
image.notes: only infobox image (unlabelled but named UA); ChamAlien appears only in UA

scoring.rationale: Camouflage (special 5) is a solid infiltration gimmick and he is agile with claws and a stinger, but his shadow, bright light, powder and keen-nosed trackers all break it, and Ben barely used him.

notes: Also used by Albedo (Negative Chamalien, dream).
